JNJ.rationale: JNJ is a fundamentally sound, defensive healthcare franchise with a wide moat, AAA balance sheet, and a 64-year dividend increase streak. The Innovative Medicine and MedTech segments are delivering solid growth (Q1 2026 revenue +9.9% YoY, raised FY2026 guidance to $100.3-$101.3B revenue and $11.45-$11.65 EPS). However, the stock is trading at a significant premium to its own recent history: the P/E of 26.8x on the14-month high of 16.-26.8 range, massive expansion from the16.6x May25-16. P6.16.6-17x range., P25-05-14. P/B of 6.95x is 4.6x a year ago. This rich valuation compresses the margin of safety despite the solid fundamental trajectory. The Stelara biosimilar headwind (~50% revenue decline for that franchise) and unquantified talc litigation risk are real offsets. Q1 2026 showed a notable EPS miss on a GAAP basis (diluted EPS of $2.14 vs. prior year's $2.77, though adjusted EPS beat estimates). Operating cash flow was weak at $2.51B in Q1 2026 vs. $9.17B in Q3 2025. The stock has also pulled back ~5.6% over the last quarter, suggesting the market may be digesting the valuation stretch. No clear near-term fundamental catalyst exists to re-rate the stock higher from already-elevated multiples. Mildly attractive on franchise quality, but valuation caps the upside.
